sourceSentences: Active: Locke hurls a nail in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit, slows them by 25% for 1 second, and applies a stack of Soul Nails for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
Against targets with at least 2 stacks, the slow is increased to 60% and lasts for 2 seconds.
For each recast not used when Ritual Nails ends, 10 to 40 of the ability's cooldown and mana cost is refunded, up to a 10*2 to 40*2 refund for two remaining recasts.
Locke's next damaging basic attack or Ashen Pursuit against an enemy with Soul Nails stacks consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage based on the amount of stacks.
Soul Ignition's recast can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.
Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion resets the cooldown.
Can dash through terrain, provided the primary target is on the other side.
If a champion takedown is scored while Ashen Pursuit is active, the ability's cooldown will be reset in addition to allowing Locke to cast Ashen Pursuit even while it is already active.
Soul Ignition can be cast during Ashen Pursuit's dash. Any other ability is queued instead.
The totem missile can be destroyed by projectile-interception effects. The homing nails that the totem fires upon targets cannot be however.
Be sure to note that Locks R is a projectile, so it can be destroyed by wind walls, but the laser that comes out after cannot be.
The two most important parts about this ability are that both parts of the E can proc the nails and it resets on takedowns.
It is fixed distance. This means depending on how close you are to the target, you'll either just reach them or go through them and the walls if they are short enough.
You can weave your E after your Q for a quick burst.

As for flash interactions, you can Q flash to extend the nails, but you can't R flash to extend the ults. E flash doesn't extend the distance of the blink, and flashing during the dash will simply cancel it.
For longer trades, you can start with E. your Q's and use the dash to proc them.
You can also wait out your Q cool down for the refund.
Start by landing all three Qs from range, then E directly onto the enemy and follow up with an auto.
For the first combo, start with E to blink into Q range, then land up to three Qs before following up with your E2 auto attack.
Your first Q marks the enemy and E1 immediately detonates it. Throw another Q before E2 to detonate a second mark, then finish with your final Q and auto.
You can Q flash to extend your reach and surprise enemies, especially after landing two Qs, allowing you to follow up with an auto to detonate your third mark.
And because E2 travels a fixed distance, you can dash over walls using a target next to you.
Your E isn't blocked by wind wall
